'''Raxus Secundus''', also known simply as '''Raxus''', was at one point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] with [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] hills and many [[Tree/Legends|trees]].

==History==
During the reign of the [[Eternal Empire]], the locals of Raxus attributed their above-average lifespans to the health benefits of the indigenous shemble-[[Berry/Legends|berry]].<ref name="Berry" />

[[File:RaxusLandscape-HOBS.png|thumb|left|200px|The picturesque landscape of Raxus]]
Raxus Secundus was located in the [[Raxus system/Legends|Raxus system]], the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]] as [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].<ref name="TCWEG" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was the [[Separatist Senate Building/Legends|site]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was heavily guarded by a [[Blockade/Legends|fleet]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]]. Separatist [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] and her family lived on the world during the conflict close to a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus city|one]] of the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to the episode guide for "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," the relationship between Raxus and the pre-existing [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] has not been specified, though the two planets were clearly designed to be different from one another.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>

When asked about any future update showing the placement of the planet Raxus compared to Raxus Prime, ''Atlas'' author [[Jason Fry]] responded that the appendix works on a system-level and he sees no reason why Raxus and Raxus Prime can't be in the same solar system.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/50075327|board=Literature|thread=The Official Jason Fry Discussion Thread|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2012-10-05|time=1:28 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180707004153/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-jason-fry-discussion-thread.50004273}}</ref> Fry later made this connection canon with Raxus's entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''.<ref name="TCWEG" />
